data.name: Enfosi
data.description:
[UPDATE - SMILE MORE]: A complete overhaul of the game, adding loads of new content and a new "maniac" difficulty!

Defend a statue while innocents glaggles rushes to it. Spot out fakes in the crowd, but beware these enphosians won't go down without a fight! Each wave will have a new glaggle appearing and even bosses to challenge your abilities! You are provided weapons, tools, and even classes to completely change up how you'll play!

Best experienced when playing on a PC, other devices works although not intended.
[NOTE]: This game is in progress, contents may change. Inspired from Glagglepedia, although has its own spin and concepts.
